 EAST Ayrshire Trading Standards has issued a warning to residents following reports of scam emails claiming to offer council tax refunds.
 The organisation has been made aware of emails circulating in the area which falsely claim to be from East Ayrshire Council's Council Tax Services.
 The messages tell recipients that their council tax accounts are in credit and include a link which supposedly allows them to claim the money.
 However, Trading Standards has confirmed that the emails are not genuine and has urged residents not to click on any links.
 Officials believe the messages are likely an attempt to obtain personal information from unsuspecting recipients.
 In a statement shared on social media, East Ayrshire Trading Standards said: "We have been made aware of residents receiving an email claiming to be from Council Tax Services claiming that their account is in credit.
 "There is a link in the email for claiming the credit.
 "Please be aware that this and any similar emails are not from East Ayrshire Council.
 "You should not click on any links as this will likely be an attempt to gather personal information."
 Anyone unsure about the authenticity of a message can contact East Ayrshire Council directly through its official website at www.east-ayrshire.gov.uk .
